_meta.status: Field names, enums and structure captured from the LIVE ROSSA submission form (study 322, ROSSA-20260930-5472) on 2026-10-03 by reading each section of the real portal. This replaces the earlier provisional guess.
_meta.notes: Covers the three assigned sections only (2a Study Information, 2b Investigators, 2c Animal Experimentation). Sex / age / sample-size (n) are NOT in these sections on the real form - they live under Phenotype Analysis > Sample Groups, which is out of scope for this assignment. Drug Treatments and Gonadectomy sub-forms are gated behind the Setup checkboxes and were not reachable for this (genetic-only) study; their fields are a best estimate from the ingestion guide and are flagged as such.

_rules: title: copy the Study Title exactly as printed, including any apparent typo. Note a suspected typo in reviewer_flags, do not correct it.

summary: the form's Study Summary is a longer narrative than a one-line abstract - 4 to 8 sentences covering aim, model, methods and main findings, based only on the article. This field may paraphrase; its evidence must still be exact quotes from the article.
funding: copy the funding statement; null if the article states none.
conflicts_of_interest: copy the competing-interests / conflict statement verbatim (often 'The authors have declared that no competing interests exist' or similar).
study_completion_date: the form wants a date. Use the publication date if no explicit study end date is given, and say so in reviewer_flags. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
has_been_published: 'yes' when the article shows a journal, volume/issue and DOI.
doi: the bare DOI (for example 10.1371/journal.pone.0148292), not the full URL.
pubmed_id: the PubMed numeric ID if the article or its header shows one; the form accepts a PubMed URL. null if not present in the text.

summary.description: Study Summary: a multi-sentence narrative (aim, model, methods, findings).

conflicts_of_interest.description: Conflicts of Interest / competing-interests statement as written.

study_completion_date.description: Study Completion Date, YYYY-MM-DD (fall back to publication date, flagged).

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier, bare DOI without URL prefix.

_rules: The form stores a LIST of investigators. Each needs a role: 'submitting', 'corresponding' or 'contributing'. A submission requires at least one submitting AND one corresponding (one person may hold both).

A paper never names who submits to ROSSA, so do NOT invent a submitting investigator - leave the list to the manuscript authors and set role 'corresponding' or 'contributing'. Flag that a submitting investigator must be added by a human.
corresponding: the author marked with an asterisk or named in a correspondence/email line.

affiliation is split into THREE fields on the real form - department, organization, country - not one string. Map the author's numbered affiliation(s) into these. If an affiliation does not separate cleanly, put the best guess and flag it.
country must be a full country name (the form uses a country dropdown, e.g. 'France', 'United States').

country.description: Country (full name, matches the form's dropdown).

_rules: setup: three booleans matching the real Setup checkboxes. genetic = uses genetically modified animals. drug = investigates a drug treatment. gonadectomy = performs a gonadectomy. Select all that apply.

animal_models: one entry per distinct animal model (what the animal IS). On the real form this does NOT include sex, age or n - those are per-cohort and live under Sample Groups (out of scope here). Do not put them here.

genetic_modification_category must be one of the real ROSSA categories (enum below). For a plain Hfe-/- targeted knockout, that is 'Global Knockout/Knockin - Gene Targeting'. Use 'No Genetic Modification' for a wild-type / plain-strain group.
For a modified model also give genetic_method (KO/KI), functional_change, and the modified gene with its species.
animal_model_name: the form asks for the source where the model was obtained (investigator or repository). Use null if the article does not state a source.

drug_treatments and gonadectomy_procedures: leave [] unless setup.drug / setup.gonadectomy is true. Do NOT record labelling agents (calcein, alizarin, tetracycline), anaesthetics or euthanasia agents as drug treatments - flag them instead. (These sub-forms are gated on the live site; fields here are a best estimate.)

drug.description: Investigates the impact of a drug treatment.

genetic_modification_category.description: ROSSA genetic-modification category for this model.

animal_model_name.description: Name/source of the model (investigator or repository).

genetic_method.description: Type of genetic modification (modified models only).

modified_gene.description: Genetically modified gene symbol (modified models only).

agent.description: Drug or agent name (experimental variable only).

age_at_surgery.description: Age when the surgery was performed.
